name: Cin7 Core
description: Cin7 Core (formerly DEAR Inventory) through External API v2: products and stock availability per location, sales with orders, fulfilments, invoices and payments (read only), purchases, customers, suppliers, stock adjustments and transfers. Create sales, purchases, customers, suppliers and transfers. Account ID and Application Key.
instructions:
## Cin7 Core
This connector works with **Cin7 Core**, the inventory management system formerly called **DEAR Inventory** (signs in at `inventory.dearsystems.com`), through its External API v2 at `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2`: products and stock availability, sales with their orders, fulfilments, invoices and payments (read only), purchases, customers, suppliers, stock adjustments and stock transfers.

**Core or Omni?** Cin7 sells two different products. **Cin7 Core** (this connector, ex DEAR Systems) uses an Account ID and an Application Key. **Cin7 Omni** (the original Cin7, go.cin7.com) has a separate API v1 with an API username and key: use the `cin7-omni` connector for it. The credentials of one do not work on the other.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. In Cin7 Core open the API setup page, **Integrations, API** (https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalAPI).
2. Click **+** to add an API application and give it a name.
3. Copy the **Account ID** into `CIN7_CORE_ACCOUNT_ID` and the **Application Key** into `CIN7_CORE_APPLICATION_KEY`.

The connector sends them in the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers. Deleting the API application revokes the key.

**Where to start**: `cin7_core_get_me` checks the connection and shows the base currency; `cin7_core_list_locations` gives location names; `cin7_core_list_sales` and `cin7_core_get_product_availability` answer most questions.

**Reading**: `cin7_core_list_products`, `cin7_core_get_product_availability`, `cin7_core_list_sales`, `cin7_core_get_sale`, `cin7_core_get_sale_order`, `cin7_core_get_sale_fulfilments`, `cin7_core_get_sale_invoices`, `cin7_core_get_sale_payments`, `cin7_core_list_purchases`, `cin7_core_get_purchase`, `cin7_core_get_purchase_order`, `cin7_core_list_customers`, `cin7_core_list_suppliers`, `cin7_core_list_tax_rules`, `cin7_core_list_payment_terms`, `cin7_core_list_stock_adjustments`, `cin7_core_get_stock_adjustment`, `cin7_core_list_stock_transfers`, `cin7_core_get_stock_transfer`.

**Creating a sale takes two calls**: `cin7_core_create_sale` makes the header (customer, location) and returns its `ID`; `cin7_core_create_sale_order` adds the lines. Lines need Name, Quantity, Price, Tax and TaxRule plus SKU or ProductID. Keep the order DRAFT unless the user wants it authorised: AUTHORISED allocates stock, backorders shortfalls silently and locks the order against further API edits. Purchases work the same way: `cin7_core_create_purchase`, then `cin7_core_create_purchase_order`.

**Other writes**: `cin7_core_create_customer`, `cin7_core_update_customer`, `cin7_core_create_supplier` (they need payment term and tax rule names and account codes), `cin7_core_create_stock_transfer` (DRAFT by default). `cin7_core_create_stock_adjustment` is installed switched off: a COMPLETED adjustment posts stock movements and accounting entries at once, and its quantities are the new on-hand values, not differences. The connector never records, changes or deletes payments, invoices or credit notes, and has no delete or void tools.

**Identifiers**: records use GUIDs (`ID`, `SaleID`, `TaskID`). Locations, tax rules, payment terms and price tiers are referenced by name.

**Paging**: lists take `page` (from 1) and `limit` (default 100, at most 1000); the answer has `Total` and the records under a list key (Products, SaleList, PurchaseList, CustomerList...). Use `updated_since` or `modified_since` for incremental reads. Dates are UTC, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss`.

**Rate limit**: **60 calls per minute** per API application; beyond that Cin7 Core answers 429 (older accounts 503). Use large pages and filters instead of many small calls.

**Errors**: a refused call answers 400 with `[{"ErrorCode": 400, "Exception": "..."}]` naming the problem (unknown customer, location or tax rule, a document that is already authorised). 403 means a wrong Account ID or Application Key.

CIN7_CORE_ACCOUNT_ID.label: Account ID
CIN7_CORE_ACCOUNT_ID.help: Cin7 Core, Integrations, API: the Account ID shown with your API application (a GUID).
CIN7_CORE_ACCOUNT_ID.patternMessage: The Account ID is a GUID such as a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4711-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b.

CIN7_CORE_APPLICATION_KEY.label: Application Key
CIN7_CORE_APPLICATION_KEY.help: Cin7 Core, Integrations, API: add an API application with + and copy its key.
CIN7_CORE_APPLICATION_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the Application Key without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Cin7 Core refused the Account ID or Application Key. Copy both again from Integrations, API. Cin7 Omni (go.cin7.com) credentials do not work here; use the Cin7 Omni connector for those.
verifyHints.403: Cin7 Core refused the Account ID or Application Key. Copy both again from Integrations, API, or add a new API application.
verifyHints.404: Cin7 Core found no record with that ID, or the endpoint is not available on this plan.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Cin7 Core allows 60 calls per minute per API application. Wait a minute and try again.

prerequisites: A Cin7 Core (DEAR Inventory) account with access to Integrations, API to create an API application. About 2 minutes.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_me
tools.description: Read the Cin7 Core account the keys belong to: company name, base currency, time zone, lock date, tax calculation method, default tax rules. A good first call to check the connection. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_locations
tools.description: List warehouses and stock locations: ID, Name, address, IsDefault, bins and whether deprecated. Location names are used by sales, purchases, availability and transfers. Read-only, paginated.

name.description: Only locations whose name starts with this.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_products
tools.description: List products (or read one by id): ID, SKU, Name, Category, Brand, Type (Stock or Service), CostingMethod, UOM, Status, Barcode, price tiers PriceTier1-10, AverageCost, DefaultLocation, weights and dimensions, LastModifiedOn. Name and SKU match by 'contains'. Read-only, paginated (list key Products).

modified_since.description: Only products changed since this UTC time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.

include_bom.description: true adds the bill of materials.

include_suppliers.description: true adds the product's suppliers and their prices.

include_reorder_levels.description: true adds reorder levels per location.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_product_availability
tools.description: Stock availability per product and location (and bin or batch): SKU, Name, Location, Bin, Batch, OnHand, Allocated, Available, OnOrder, StockOnHand (value), InTransit, NextDeliveryDate. Filter by SKU (exact), name (starts with), location name or category. Read-only, paginated (list key ProductAvailabilityList).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_sales
tools.description: List sales (quotes, orders and invoices share one sale record): SaleID, OrderNumber, Status, OrderDate, Customer, CustomerID, InvoiceNumber, CustomerReference, totals, currency, OrderStatus, CombinedPickingStatus, CombinedPackingStatus, CombinedShippingStatus, CombinedInvoiceStatus, CreditNoteStatus, Updated. Search matches order number, status, customer, invoice number, customer reference or credit note number. Read-only, paginated (list key SaleList).

search.description: Text to look for in order number, customer, invoice number, customer reference, credit note number or status.

created_since.description: Only sales created since this UTC time.

updated_since.description: Only sales changed since this UTC time.

status.description: Only sales in this overall status.

order_status.description: Only sales whose order is in this status.

invoice_status.description: Only sales with this combined invoice status.

ship_by.description: Only sales due to ship by this date.

external_id.description: Only the sale with this ExternalID (set by an integration).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_sale
tools.description: Read one sale with its header (customer, contact, addresses, location, tax rule, terms, price tier, ship-by date, status) and the quote, order, fulfilments, invoices, credit notes and payments it contains. Read-only.

hide_inventory_movements.description: true leaves out inventory movements to keep the answer short.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_sale_order
tools.description: Read the order part of a sale: SaleOrderNumber, Status (DRAFT, AUTHORISED...), Memo, Lines (ProductID, SKU, Name, Quantity, Price, Discount, Tax, TaxRule, BackorderQuantity, Total) and additional charges. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_sale_fulfilments
tools.description: Read the fulfilments of a sale: pick, pack and ship stages with their status, lines, boxes, carrier and tracking numbers. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_sale_invoices
tools.description: Read the invoices of a sale: TaskID, InvoiceNumber, Status, InvoiceDate, InvoiceDueDate, lines, totals and amounts paid. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_sale_payments
tools.description: Read the payments, prepayments and refunds recorded on a sale: Type, Amount, DatePaid, Account, Reference, currency rate. Read-only: this connector never records or changes payments.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_purchases
tools.description: List purchases: ID, OrderNumber, Status, OrderDate, Supplier, SupplierID, InvoiceNumber, totals, currency, OrderStatus, StockReceivedStatus, InvoiceStatus, RequiredBy, LastUpdatedDate. Read-only, paginated (list key PurchaseList).

search.description: Text to look for in order number, supplier, invoice number or status.

updated_since.description: Only purchases changed since this UTC time.

required_by.description: Only purchases required by this date.

status.description: Only purchases in this overall status.

order_status.description: Only purchases whose order is in this status.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_purchase
tools.description: Read one purchase (simple, advanced or service) with supplier, location, approach, tax rule, terms, order, stock received, invoices and status. Uses the advanced purchase endpoint, which serves every purchase type. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Read the order part of a purchase: Status, Memo, Lines (ProductID, SKU, SupplierSKU, Name, Quantity, Price, Discount, Tax, TaxRule, Total) and additional charges. Read-only.

purchase_id.description: Purchase ID (GUID); the API calls it TaskID here.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (or read one by id): ID, Name, Status, Currency, PaymentTerm, TaxRule, PriceTier, Discount, CreditLimit, IsOnCreditHold, Tags, Location, SalesRepresentative, addresses and contacts. Name matches by 'starts with'; contact_filter matches a contact name start or an exact email. Read-only, paginated (list key CustomerList).

contact_filter.description: Contact name starts with this, or the exact contact email.

modified_since.description: Only customers changed since this UTC time.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (or read one by id): ID, Name, Status, Currency, PaymentTerm, AccountPayable, TaxRule, Discount, TaxNumber, addresses and contacts. Read-only, paginated (list key SupplierList).

modified_since.description: Only suppliers changed since this UTC time.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_tax_rules
tools.description: List tax rules: ID, Name, Code, TaxPercent, IsTaxForSale, IsTaxForPurchase, IsActive, Account. Tax rule names are required on order lines, customers and suppliers. Read-only, paginated (list key TaxRuleList).

name.description: Only tax rules with this name.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_payment_terms
tools.description: List payment terms: ID, Name, Duration, Method, IsActive, IsDefault. Names are required on customers and suppliers. Read-only, paginated (list key PaymentTermList).

name.description: Only the term with this name.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_stock_adjustments
tools.description: List stock adjustments: TaskID, StocktakeNumber, EffectiveDate, Status (DRAFT, COMPLETED, VOIDED), Reference, Account. Read-only, paginated (list key StockAdjustmentList).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_stock_adjustment
tools.description: Read one stock adjustment with its lines (ExistingStockLines, NewStockLines: SKU, location, quantity on hand, adjustment, unit cost, batch) and the transactions it posted. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_list_stock_transfers
tools.description: List stock transfers between locations: TaskID, Number, Status (DRAFT, IN TRANSIT, COMPLETED, VOIDED), From and To locations, DepartureDate, CompletionDate, Reference. Read-only, paginated (list key StockTransferList).

search.description: Text to look for in number or reference.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Total in the answer gives the number of records.

tools.name: cin7_core_get_stock_transfer
tools.description: Read one stock transfer with its lines (SKU, TransferQuantity, batch) and status. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_sale
tools.description: Create a sale header (customer, location, terms, tax rule, addresses). It has no lines yet: add them with cin7_core_create_sale_order using the returned ID. Set skip_quote true to go straight to an order. Takes no payment.

customer_reference.description: The customer's reference or PO number.

tax_rule.description: Default tax rule name; default the customer's.

terms.description: Payment term name; default the customer's.

price_tier.description: Price tier name; default the customer's.

currency_rate.description: Required when the customer's currency differs from the base currency: base units per customer currency unit.

ShipToOther.description: true for an address not saved on the customer.

external_id.description: Your own id for this sale, to find it again with cin7_core_list_sales.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_sale_order
tools.description: Add the order lines to a sale created with cin7_core_create_sale. Status DRAFT (default) keeps it editable; AUTHORISED allocates stock, silently backorders what is short and locks the order against further API edits. Only works while the order is DRAFT or not yet created.

Price.description: Price per unit in the customer's (or supplier's) currency.

lines.description: Lines: [{"SKU": "AF308", "Name": "Tide Pool", "Quantity": 2, "Price": 8, "Tax": 0, "TaxRule": "Tax on Sales"}]. Give SKU or ProductID.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_purchase
tools.description: Create a purchase header for a supplier (advanced purchase endpoint, which serves simple and advanced purchases). Add lines with cin7_core_create_purchase_order using the returned ID. Approach INVOICE means the invoice comes first, STOCK means stock is received first.

location.description: Location name to receive stock into.

approach.description: STOCK (default): stock is received before the invoice; INVOICE: invoice first.

purchase_type.description: Simple (default) or Advanced (several receipts and invoices).

tax_rule.description: Default tax rule name; default the supplier's.

terms.description: Payment term name; default the supplier's.

currency_rate.description: Base units per supplier currency unit, when the currency differs.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_purchase_order
tools.description: Add the order lines to a purchase created with cin7_core_create_purchase. Status DRAFT (default) keeps it editable; AUTHORISED sends it on and locks it against further API edits.

Price.description: Price per unit in the customer's (or supplier's) currency.

lines.description: Lines: [{"SKU": "AF308", "Name": "Tide Pool", "Quantity": 24, "Price": 3.2, "Tax": 0, "TaxRule": "Tax on Purchases", "Total": 76.8}]. Give SKU or ProductID; Total is checked against quantity, price and tax.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Cin7 Core requires name, currency, payment term, tax rule and the receivable and revenue account codes; read valid names with cin7_core_list_payment_terms and cin7_core_list_tax_rules. Returns the new record wrapped in CustomerList.

account_receivable.description: Accounts receivable account code, e.g. 610 (cin7_core_get_me shows defaults).

tools.name: cin7_core_update_customer
tools.description: Update a customer by ID; only the fields given change. Setting status Deprecated hides the customer from new sales.

account_receivable.description: Accounts receivable account code, e.g. 610 (cin7_core_get_me shows defaults).

tools.name: cin7_core_create_supplier
tools.description: Create a supplier. Cin7 Core requires name, currency, payment term, tax rule and the payable account code. Returns the new record wrapped in SupplierList.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_stock_adjustment
tools.description: Create a stock adjustment. Each line's Quantity is the NEW quantity on hand at that location, not a difference. Status DRAFT (default) only saves it; COMPLETED posts the stock movements and accounting transactions at once. Installed switched off.

account.description: Expense account code for the adjustment.

update_on_hand.description: true adjusts on-hand quantity; default false adjusts available quantity.

BatchSN.description: Batch or serial number; required unless costing is FIFO.

tools.name: cin7_core_create_stock_transfer
tools.description: Create a stock transfer between two locations. Status DRAFT (default) only saves it; COMPLETED moves the stock at once (IN TRANSIT also needs the in-transit account and departure date). Lines take SKU or ProductID and TransferQuantity.

from_location.description: Name of the location the stock leaves.

to_location.description: Name of the location the stock goes to.

departure_date.description: Date the stock left; required for IN TRANSIT.

in_transit_account.description: Asset account code holding the stock while in transit; required for IN TRANSIT.

required_by_date.description: Date the stock is needed at the destination.

BatchSN.description: Batch or serial number; required unless costing is FIFO.
